messages:
nguyen: Heads-up: new support case where sample app deadlocks when auth token refresh + context timeout happen during a generator stream. Repro in a tiny sample.

tara: Ugh. Which pattern are they using? `for gen.Next()` or a manual Recv loop?

nguyen: Standard `for gen.Next()` loop from quickstart. When token rotates we do a reconnect under the hood, and if the request context is Cancelled mid-Next() the client sometimes leaves a goroutine behind or returns a generic EOF. Users couldn't tell if they should retry.

paul: Can you paste the minimal repro? Also SDK version.

nguyen: go-sdk v0.13.1, repro gist: https://gist.github.com/nguyen/repro-gen-ctx-rotate. Snippet:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()
g, _ := client.Generator(ctx, "xlarge", nil)
for g.Next() {
  fmt.Print(g.Value().Text)
}
err := g.Err()
log.Println("done, err=", err)
_ = g.Close()
```

paul: Sounds similar to before but slightly different symptoms. UX asks: what should user see when ctx cancels vs when server reconnects?

tara: We should make semantics explicit: - ctx cancellation -> Next() returns false and Err()==context.Canceled - auth reconnects/transport retries -> surfaced as ErrRetryable (so callers can choose to continue/abort) - Close() must be safe to call multiple times and never panic.

nguyen: Agreed. Also request: provide a tiny helper iterator that integrates ctx into the loop so onboarding doesn't teach the goroutine-with-select pattern. Something like: `for gen.NextWith(ctx) { ... }` or `iter := gen.Iter(ctx); for iter.Next() { ... }`

paul: I prefer NextWith to keep API surface minimal. Implementation detail: NextWith should call internal transport loop with select on user ctx and internal done channel. Make sure to document that Err() can return ErrRetryable (transient) vs context.Canceled.

qa-bot: test plan suggestion: create flaky test harness that simulates token rotation by forcing the auth middleware to return 401 twice then succeed; run 1000 iterations to check no goroutine leaks.

nguyen: I'll open a PR with three changes: 1) Close idempotent (sync.Once), 2) NextWith(ctx) helper, 3) well-typed errors (ErrRetryable, ErrCanceled, ErrStreamClosed). I'll include the test harness from qa-bot. PR link when ready.

tara: Nice. Once PR merges, we should add a one-file example in go-sdk-samples that demonstrates recommended pattern and a short blurb in quickstart: "Use NextWith(ctx) or ensure you call Close() in a defer; don't spawn ad-hoc goroutines to handle ctx cancel."

paul: Also add a note on what to do for long-lived streams where you expect transient auth interruptions: prefer to surface ErrRetryable and let app-level logic decide to resume from the last successful token (or re-create a generator).

nguyen: Filing PR now. Will tag you both. :rocket:
